event observation

  • CURIE: gmeow:eventObservation
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventObservation
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/events

An observation made during or about an event. Inverse of gmeow:observationEvent (observations module). Non-functional: an event may have many observations, and competing standpoint-indexed observations coexist (Principle 9).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Event -> gmeow:Observation

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:eventObservation from gmeow:Event to gmeow:Observation when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Event, gmeow:Observation
